brand-primary.$description: Brand orange (palette). DECORATIVE USE ONLY per 2026 brand guide (May 2026). Allowed: filled-icon fills, blob shapes, accents, borders. NEVER use as section/button background; orange + white text fails contrast. White standalone logo on orange background is the only exception (social profile + print covers, no text).

brand-secondary.$description: Brand blue (palette). Special announcements and alerts; always pair with white text (#FFF). Elementor Global 1.

brand-dark.$description: Charcoal (palette)—primary text on light backgrounds. Elementor Global 3.

accent.$description: Warm white (palette)—text-heavy content backgrounds; pair with Charcoal text. Elementor Global 4.

focus-button.$description: Focus Button — primary button hover/pressed state (Elementor Custom 1)

light-purple.$description: Lavender (palette)—decorative: blobs, icons, accents, borders; prefer Soft Lavender for large readable backgrounds. Elementor Custom 2.

soft-lavender.$description: Soft lavender (palette)—social/layout backgrounds; pair with Charcoal text. Map in Elementor as an additional Custom Color if available.

light-green.$description: Lime green (palette)—title/key layout backgrounds; pair with Charcoal; decorative accents. Elementor Custom 3.

light-orange.$description: Light Orange — soft CTA background, hover tint (Elementor Custom 4)

very-light-gray.$description: Very Light Gray — light section backgrounds (Elementor Custom 8)

background-default.$description: Semantic — text-heavy content background. Alias of Warm White; pair with Charcoal text.

background-soft.$description: Semantic — decorative content background (cards, sections). Alias of Soft Lavender; pair with Charcoal text.

background-title.$description: Semantic — title / key layout background. Alias of Lime Green; pair with Charcoal text.

background-alert.$description: Semantic — special announcements / alerts only. Alias of Brand Blue; pair with white text.

accent-icon.$description: Semantic — filled-icon fill (category markers). Alias of Brand Orange; pair with Charcoal labels or white glyph inside the icon shape only.

accent-border.$description: Semantic — decorative border / underline accent. Alias of Brand Orange; never use as a fill background for elements containing text.

theme-1.$description: Theme Color 1 — WordPress/Elementor theme blue (Theme slot 1)

theme-2.$description: Charcoal-aligned — primary body text (Theme slot 2); matches palette Charcoal.

theme-4.$description: Theme Color 4 — mid-dark UI text (Theme slot 4)

theme-5.$description: Theme Color 5 — light neutral surface (Theme slot 5)

theme-8.$description: Theme Color 8 — support text; aligned to Charcoal (Theme slot 8)

50.$description: Neutral 50 — lightest surface tint (2026 style guide ramp).

100.$description: Neutral 100 — light surface; aligns with theme-5.

900.$description: Neutral 900 (Neutral_main) — Charcoal, primary text on light backgrounds.

150.$description: Orange 150 — light orange surface; aligns with light-orange.

300.$description: Orange 300 (Peach) — warm accent; aligns with status.warning.

500.$description: Orange 500 (Orange_main) — Brand orange. DECORATIVE ONLY: icons, blobs, accents, borders; never a text background.

600.$description: Orange 600 — primary-button hover/pressed; aligns with focus-button.

500.$description: Green 500 (Green_main) — Lime green. Title/key-layout backgrounds with Charcoal text; aligns with light-green/status.success.
Blue 500 (Blue_main) — Brand blue. Announcements/alerts only; always pair with white text.

300.$description: Lavender 300 — soft lavender; aligns with soft-lavender background.

500.$description: Lavender 500 (Lavender_main) — Lavender. Decorative: blobs, icons, accents, borders; aligns with light-purple.
